title: Release wave 2026-05-11: uuencoding 0.3, uuencoding-multi 0.2.1, mime-tree 0.3, smime-tree 0.3
description:
Coordinated crates.io publish wave covering the unpublished work accumulated since the 2026-05-04 publish window.

Forced publish order (dep graph):
1. uuencoding 0.3.0 — already version-bumped locally in commit d8b22fd; 2 review-loop fix commits since 0.2.0
2. uuencoding-multi 0.2.1 — 2 review-loop fix commits, needs uuencoding 0.3.0 published first
3. mime-tree 0.3.0 — depends on uuencoding 0.3.0; breaking byte-range type change + RFC 8621 typed-header API
4. smime-tree 0.3.0 — depends on mime-tree 0.3.0; large breaking+correctness batch (ECDH/KARI, SystemTime, RevocationChecker, multi-signer, non_exhaustive, P-384 digest-selection bugfix)

Pre-publish quality gate already run and passed: cargo fmt, clippy -D warnings, full workspace test suite.

Skip in this wave: yencoding, yencoding-multi (0 commits since last publish).
close_reason: Publish wave complete. 6 crates published (uuencoding 0.3.0, uuencoding-multi 0.2.1, yencoding 0.2.0, yencoding-multi 0.2.0, mime-tree 0.3.0, smime-tree 0.3.0).
